name: Waldorf Astoria Maldives Ithaafushi
insider_take: This ultra-luxe resort spans three pristine islands connected by bridges, offering the Maldives' first underwater restaurant and spa treatments in overwater pavilions.
whats_special: The Waldorf Astoria Maldives features the world's largest overwater villa at 32,000 square feet, complete with a private chef and yacht. The resort's signature Terra restaurant sits 20 feet below sea level, surrounded by vibrant coral reefs and marine life. Each villa comes with a dedicated butler and private beach access.
pro_tip: Book the Stella Maris dining experience - a private sandbank dinner under the stars that's only accessible by seaplane, creating an unforgettable romantic evening in complete isolation.
dont_miss: The resort's coral regeneration program where guests can participate in planting coral fragments, and the weekly manta ray excursions to nearby Hanifaru Bay, a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve where hundreds of manta rays gather to feed during certain seasons.
pros: Ultra-luxury overwater and beach villas with private pools
Exceptional personalized butler service and attention to detail
World-class dining with multiple award-winning restaurants
Pristine private island setting with crystal-clear lagoons
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Remote island location requires seaplane transfers
